holidays.name: National Puppy Day
holidays.description: A day to cuddle, adopt, and spoil puppies of every size, with a big push to support shelters and rescue groups. Expect a lot of squishy faces and wagging tails on social media.
holidays.origin: Founded in 2006 by pet and family lifestyle expert and animal advocate Colleen Paige, who also started National Dog Day. The day aims to raise awareness of puppy mill abuse and to encourage adoption.
holidays.funFact: The day is meant to celebrate puppies of all breeds and mixes, including the shelter pups still waiting for homes.

holidays.name: National Chip and Dip Day
holidays.description: A salute to the greatest team in snacking: crunchy chips and creamy, zesty dips. Salsa, guacamole, onion dip and queso all get to share the spotlight.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial food observance of unclear origin. It's celebrated by snack lovers across the United States.
holidays.funFact: The dish is a staple of game-day parties, where chips and dips are often among the most popular snacks.

holidays.name: National Chia Day
holidays.description: A day for tiny seeds with big personalities. Chia seeds go into puddings, smoothies and breakfast bowls, and they swell into a gel when soaked in liquid.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin, celebrated by fans of the nutritious little seed.
holidays.funFact: Chia seeds can soak up many times their weight in water. That's why they turn into a gel, and why a certain 1980s clay-pet TV jingle comes to mind.
